visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a large, blue-lined water trough filled with numerous small goldfish swimming around. A woman's hands are seen holding a small white plastic cup and a paper net, dipping them into the water. (2) The camera transitions to a medium shot of a young woman with long brown hair, wearing a white sleeveless top and a wristwatch, sitting at the edge of the trough. She is smiling and focused on catching the fish. Around her, other people of various ages are also seated around the long trough, engaged in the same activity. The setting is an outdoor night market, with stalls and artificial lighting visible in the background. (3) The woman repeatedly dips her net into the water, her facial expressions showing concentration and then amusement as her paper net breaks. She gestures with her hands while talking to someone off-camera. (4) The camera focuses on the water surface as she attempts to scoop a fish. We see several failed attempts where the paper in the net tears under the weight of the water. (5) In a triumphant moment, she successfully catches a small orange goldfish and carefully transfers it into her cup. She looks up at the camera with a wide grin and gives a thumbs-up. (6) A slow-motion replay section follows, showing the fish swimming near the surface and her net moving underneath it. However, as she lifts the cup, the fish is seen jumping out and splashing back into the trough. (7) The woman looks at her empty cup with a playful, disappointed expression, showing it to the camera to indicate she has no fish left. (8) The video ends with a still graphic featuring a portrait of the woman, surrounded by an autumn-leaf themed border, with social media icons and call-to-action text.

Her voice becomes more animated, laughing when she mentions the net breaking. (3) A sharp 'ding' sound effect highlights a specific tip she shares. The background music maintains a consistent rhythm while her speech rate fluctuates with her excitement. (4) A loud, celebratory 'vocal SFX' occurs when she successfully catches a fish, followed by a wet 'splash' as she puts it in the cup. (5) During the slow-motion visual, the music slightly ducks, and a comedic 'slide whistle' or 'cartoon whoosh' sound effect plays as the fish jumps back into the water, followed by the woman's disappointed but laughing exclamation. It focuses on the difficulty and amusement of catching goldfish with delicate paper nets, ultimately showing a successful catch that ends in a humorous failure when the fish jumps away.
